nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Keep your voices down. The goblins took the keep three nights ago, and they dragged Tobb the miller in with them.

choices.text: We'll clear them out and bring Tobb home.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Grak. Big for a goblin, and mean with it. He holds the far hall on the east side. The storeroom is north of the entry hall; that's where I'd keep a prisoner.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Then go quietly. Get through the gate to the east and watch the shadows. Goblins see in the dark better than you do.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Fine. The mill pays twenty silver when Tobb walks out of there. Don't spend it before you've earned it.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Then you're not heroes, are you? Help or don't. Tobb doesn't have time for haggling.
